project.one_liner: Generates a travel itinerary for a destination and lets you adjust it on a map

launch_features: Link out to book hotels on a third-party platform
assumptions: Hotel prices and availability come from a third-party platform API [assumed]
Bookings are completed on the third-party platform [assumed]

value_realization.note: Itinerary management happens in the product; booking happens on the third-party platform

removal_test.generate: Without it the product breaks: users come to get an itinerary
removal_test.retrieve: Removable; 15% of activity, below the secondary threshold
removal_test.tool: Removable but clearly worse; 45% of activity, so it is the secondary type

type_checks.pitch_check: The user describes it as 'plans your trip for you', consistent with generate [stated]
type_checks.not_transaction: Booking is only a link out to a third-party platform

data.evidence: Live prices and availability require a partner API [assumed]

action.evidence: Booking links out to a third-party platform [assumed]

network.evidence: Travel companions vote on itinerary changes together [stated]

trust.evidence: Users can fix itinerary mistakes themselves [inferred]
